lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Withdrawn at third reading, to a small noise of approval from four members who wanted to go home.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: It comes back as a schedule to a finance act. Same eleven pages, no long title, no gallery, no third reading, and no me, because clerks do not attend schedules. That is not a guess. I have watched it happen four times with four different bills.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It passes in the spring, inside a schedule, unamended and undebated — and without the naming clause, because nobody is in the room to move one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everything after that happens in the dark rather than in daylight. It changes nothing about what happens. It changes everything about whether anyone can ever find it.
